primary_claim: A recurrent CNN trained to solve 9x9 mazes and applied to a 33x33 maze implements a 'dead-end filling' pathfinding algorithm, functioning as a simple learned optimizer whose narrow goal range limits its usefulness as a case study for more capable mesa-optimizers.

models.family: Recurrent CNN (Bansal et al. maze solver)

limitations_stated: The range of goals the algorithm is able to optimize is very limited, and as such it is not very useful for studying more capable mesa-optimizers.
quote: It can optimize for connecting any two goals, and is thus technically a learned optimizer. However, the range of goals that it is able to optimize is very limited.
